title: Dynamic Product List
prompt: Render a product list with prices, stable unique keys, and formatted totals. Submit the relevant snippet or implementation notes and validate behavior in a local Vue 3 project. For the current CodeLeaf text grader, include these exact case-sensitive marker strings in your submission: v-for, object, stable. Passing the marker check is not proof of runtime correctness; CodeLeaf does not run arbitrary Vue code.

starter.run_instructions: Use a separate local Vue 3/create-vue project for runtime behavior. For architecture, security, accessibility, performance, SSR, and migration tasks, submit a reproducible plan and evidence rather than assuming CodeLeaf executes the code.

public_tests.name: Configured static marker check
public_tests.description: The server checks for the exact required strings only. It does not execute Vue code or establish that runtime behavior, accessibility, or architecture is correct; use the acceptance criteria and local verification steps too.

acceptance_criteria: The submission demonstrates the named skills: v-for, object data, stable keys.
Expected visible behavior or review evidence is reproducible and clearly stated.
A normal case plus a relevant boundary/failure case is addressed.
Accessibility, security, version, and server trust boundaries are considered where relevant.
hints: Start with one observable success case.
Compare expected behavior against the actual output or written evidence.
Try an empty, invalid, delayed, or failed case that is relevant to the task.
grading_method: Server-side, case-sensitive literal-marker check only. This does not execute code or prove runtime correctness; behavior and acceptance criteria must be reviewed separately before publication.
retry_policy: Retry is allowed; incorrect submissions award no XP. The platform owns the fixed exercise XP rules and awards a reward only after the configured server-side check first succeeds.
